supersedes: TRACKA-HL-EARLY4H-2025H1-LIQ-GLM (prereg 20261112T164838Z, INCONCLUSIVE_NUMERICAL_INSTABILITY). Estimator-only successor; the sealed 134503Z prereg and its rv result are not modified.

universe.concentration_note: BTC+ETH are ~63.6% of events and ~83.6% of notional; per-coin reporting is mandatory and no PASS may be driven by one coin.

targets.definition: next-24h observed liquidation notional USD; QLIKE loss. Only this target is tested.

C2.form: HAR-RV + bounded funding + bounded premium log-link GLM

feature_transform.rule: For each of these columns, compute the observed [min, max] on the TRAIN split (positive t1_liq rows only). Clip the value to that [min, max]. Then standardize as z = (clipped - train_mean) / train_std using train mean/std. RV log features are unchanged.
feature_transform.purpose: Prevent the log-link linear predictor from extrapolating outside the training support (the sole cause of the parent INCONCLUSIVE verdict: block-3 funding/premium/ema_dist are 27.7x / 12.5x / 4.5x outside the training range).
feature_transform.no_tuning: Percentiles, means and stds are computed once from the train split; no outcome-dependent selection.

estimator.numerical_safeguards: eta clipped to [-30, 30]; mu floored at 1e-12; IRLS <=100 iterations with step-halving on deviance increase.

contrasts.multiple_testing: Holm across the full declared contrast family
contrasts.direction: QLIKE lower is better; diff = QLIKE(C2) - QLIKE(B1); PASS needs mean diff < 0

metric_scope: rows with t1_liq > 0 only (identical to the sealed campaign and the parent liq-glm campaign; QLIKE undefined at y=0).

inference.method: block bootstrap over complete 30-day UTC blocks

numerical_stability.note: If this fires again, emit a timestamped evidenced structural-blocker document with the exact failing minima and stop; do not iterate estimator forms without a materially new source or a new preregistered design.

missingness_policy: missing stays missing; no forward fill; no synthetic labels; listwise deletion within each model's feature set.
